notes: Created 2026-10-29; creation date is not a market quotation date. User prompt supplied grey PKR 2600–3800, economy turnkey 5200–5800, standard turnkey 6000–8000, premium turnkey 8000–12000, luxury 12000+. Selected scenario values are grey 3200; economy total 5500; standard 7000; premium 10000. These are unverified scenario choices, not observed averages. The grey/finishing split is an explicit modelling assumption, not a measured split. Luxury finishing stays null because an open-ended range has no defensible selected value. Lahore multiplier 1 is a base normalization, not evidence of current local prices. Other city multipliers, material prices, labour shares and fees remain null until supported by quotations. Per-area scope excludes extra charges supplied separately. Units must match BOQ rules exactly; define all bag masses, trolley volumes and material specifications before conversion. To edit safely, validate using tools.cost.RateCatalog and use the settings page when delivered.
